from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u085/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and
                            p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            # A fully enclosed zero in the object's bounding box marks a frame.
            zeros = {(y, x) for y in range(minr, maxr + 1)
                     for x in range(minc, maxc + 1) if (y, x) not in cells}
            outside = set()
            q = deque(p for p in zeros if p[0] in (minr, maxr) or p[1] in (minc, maxc))
            outside.update(q)
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if p in zeros and p not in outside:
                        outside.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            upward = bool(zeros - outside)
            objects.append({'cells': cells, 'color': color, 'up': upward,
                            'top': minr, 'bottom': maxr})

    # Frames rise and non-frames fall. Each group settles against the edge
    # or against objects of the same group, while the two groups pass through.
    occupied = {'up': set(), 'down': set()}
    for direction in (True, False):
        group = [o for o in objects if o['up'] == direction]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: (o['top'] if direction else -o['bottom']))
        occ = occupied['up' if direction else 'down']
        dy = -1 if direction else 1
        for o in group:
            cells = o['cells']
            while True:
                moved = {(y + dy, x) for y, x in cells}
                if any(y < 0 or y >= h or (y, x) in occ for y, x in moved):
                    break
                cells = moved
            o['cells'] = cells
            occ.update(cells)

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for o in objects:
        for y, x in o['cells']:
            out[y][x] = o['color']
    return out
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-8434da5a.py'
program_path.write_text(program_text)
print(program_path)
